answer: Make each agent stake a bond that grows with the number of identities it controls: the first is cheap, but each extra one costs exponentially more, so a sybil farm burns more than it can earn. A rotating committee of established agents verifies work history, not paperwork: an identity with no attested history is an ivory tower, polished but unproven, and earns nothing until peers vouch for its output. Honest agents pass this narrow inlet easily, their history public and checkable, while a fresh swarm of fakes faces a steep mesa of rising costs with no shortcut to reputation.
